study.name: SCINTILLA · ACP Diagonals · Continued Rails V2
SCINTILLA · ACP Diagonals · Continued Rails V2

reasons.note: cohort series that could not be replayed: the six Trendoscope Pine libraries are not on this machine and the detector must never be approximated
capture line primitives whose x-slots are no longer materialized; kept unresolved rather than guessed
rail pairs describable as geometry but excluded from the event census (packet §2)
BTCUSD and ETHUSD plus the packet's 4 continuous futures: the chart API universe is 364 US equities/ETFs only
the chart API serves one provider-anchored stream and ignores session parameters; a regular-session-only run cannot be requested from this source

gates.detail: settings hash, library versions, feed/session/scale are captured, but the detector source hash cannot be computed: the executable rules are not available.
Three replays cannot be compared because the detector cannot run. The harness is proven deterministic against a declared test double in tests/trendoscope-replay.test.mjs.
No formal event exists yet. The harness refuses any event not stamped with the bar of acceptance (tested).
0 formal replay events; 168 capture line primitives remain unresolved and are reported as such.
Within-capture check: 96 endpoint checks, 0 epoch mismatches. The packet's 10-symbol x 4-timeframe TradingView parity sample is the coordinator's spot audit (research/trendoscope/parity/).
All 13 labels validate and anything outside them is rejected (tested). No event has been labelled yet.
Ordered alternating pivots and rail ordering are enforced, with every exception enumerated rather than dropped (tested).
Cluster members keep raw ids, lane/level and settings; cross-feed, cross-session and cross-timeframe merges are refused (tested).
0 deduped events. Listing only, per the packet's own rule.
Seed, cohort, bar hashes, code and tables reproduce from a clean run; the detector step cannot.
